title: Qiyosiy daraja: kattaroq, yaxshiroq
goal_uz: Dars oxirida sifatlarning qiyosiy darajasini (-er, more, better, worse) to‘g‘ri yasaysiz, than va as … as bilan ikki narsani solishtirasiz, much va a bit bilan farq darajasini bildirasiz hamda ikki shahar haqida sakkizta gap aytib bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Solishtirishni o‘rganamiz
scenes.say: Hello again! Last time we talked about holidays in the past. Today we compare things: cities, people and products.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda kelajak rejalari va niyatlar haqida gaplashdik. Bugun esa ikki narsani solishtirishni o‘rganamiz: shaharlarni, odamlarni va mahsulotlarni. Dars oxirida qiyosiy daraja shaklini to‘g‘ri yasaysiz, “than” va “as… as” ni ishlatasiz, “much” va “a bit” bilan farq katta yoki kichikligini aytasiz va ikki shahar haqida sakkizta gap tuzasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Oldingi darsda kelajak rejalari haqida gaplashdik. Bugun shaharlarni, odamlarni va mahsulotlarni solishtiramiz.

scenes.title: Qiyosiy daraja nima?

examples.t: My flat is bigger than yours.

scenes.say: This flat is big. That flat is bigger. This phone is expensive. That phone is more expensive.
scenes.say_native: Qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtirish uchun ishlatiladi. O‘zbek tilida sifatga “-roq” qo‘shamiz: katta — kattaroq, arzon — arzonroq, qimmat — qimmatroq. Ingliz tilida ikki yo‘l bor: qisqa sifatga “-er” qo‘shamiz, uzun sifat oldiga esa “more” qo‘yamiz. Qaysi yo‘l qachon kerakligi sifatning uzunligiga bog‘liq. Hozir ikkalasini ketma-ket ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kvartira katta. U kvartira kattaroq. Bu telefon qimmat. U telefon qimmatroq.

scenes.title: Qisqa sifatlar: + -er
scenes.say: Anna is taller than Tom. This bus is faster. The market is cheaper. My car is older.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi qoida: bir bo‘g‘inli sifatlarga “-er” qo‘shamiz. Tall — taller, cheap — cheaper, fast — faster, old — older, small — smaller, cold — colder, long — longer. Bir bo‘g‘in nima? Bu bitta unli tovush bilan aytiladigan qism: “tall”, “cheap”. Shuning uchun ular uchun “more tall” demaymiz. Oxiridagi “-er” kuchsiz, yengil “a” kabi o‘qiladi: taller, “TAW-la”.
scenes.say_uz: Anna Tomdan balandroq. Bu avtobus tezroq. Bozor arzonroq. Mening mashinam eskiroq.

scenes.title: Imlo: -e, qo‘sh undosh, -y
scenes.say: Nice, nicer. Large, larger. Big, bigger. Hot, hotter. Happy, happier. Easy, easier.
scenes.say_native: Imlo qoidalari. Agar sifat “e” bilan tugasa, faqat “r” qo‘shamiz: nice — nicer, large — larger. Agar sifat bitta unli va bitta undosh bilan tugasa, undosh ikkilanadi: big — bigger, hot — hotter, thin — thinner. Agar sifat “undosh plus y” bilan tugasa, “y” ni “i” ga almashtirib “-er” qo‘shamiz: happy — happier, easy — easier, busy — busier. “Y” oldida undosh turishi shart.
scenes.say_uz: Chiroyli, chiroyliroq. Katta, kattaroq. Issiq, issiqroq. Xursand, xursandroq. Oson, osonroq.

scenes.title: Eshiting: shaharlar
board: The metro is faster than the bus.
scenes.say: Tashkent is bigger than Bukhara. Bukhara is quieter and calmer. Winter in Moscow is colder than winter in Tashkent. The metro is faster than the bus.
scenes.say_native: Endi tayyor gaplarni eshiting. Toshkent Buxorodan kattaroq. Buxoro tinchroq. Moskvada qish Toshkentdagi qishdan sovuqroq. Metro avtobusdan tezroq. Har bir gapda ikki narsa taqqoslanyapti va ular orasida “than” turibdi. Yana bir narsa: “quieter” — “quiet” dan, ikki bo‘g‘inli sifat, lekin u ham “-er” oladi. Bu haqda keyinroq gaplashamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Toshkent Buxorodan kattaroq. Buxoro tinchroq. Moskvada qish Toshkentdagi qishdan sovuqroq. Metro avtobusdan tezroq.

scenes.title: Qiyosiy darajani yasang
scenes.say: Make the comparative. Small. Cold. Nice. Big. Happy. Busy.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Oltita sifatning qiyosiy darajasini ayting: small, cold, nice, big, happy, busy. Imlo qoidalarini eslang: oxirida “e”, ikkilangan undosh yoki “y” ni “i” ga almashtirish. Har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Qiyosiy darajani yasang. Kichik. Sovuq. Yoqimli. Katta. Xursand. Band.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: small → smaller   cold → colder   nice → nicer
big → bigger   happy → happier   busy → busier
scenes.say: Smaller. Colder. Nicer. Bigger. Happier. Busier.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: smaller, colder, nicer, bigger, happier, busier. Agar “nicer” ni “nicier” deb aytgan bo‘lsangiz, esda tuting: faqat “y” bilan tugagan sifatlar “-ier” oladi. Agar “biger” deb yozgan bo‘lsangiz, undoshni ikkilash kerak: “bigger”, chunki qisqa unlidan keyin bitta undosh bor. Bu yozma imlo qoidasi, talaffuz esa deyarli o‘zgarmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Kichikroq. Sovuqroq. Yoqimliroq. Kattaroq. Xursandroq. Bandroq.

scenes.title: Uzun sifatlar: more + sifat

examples.t: Paris is more beautiful in spring.

scenes.say: This hotel is more comfortable. That film was more interesting. London is more expensive than Tashkent.
scenes.say_native: Ikki va undan ko‘p bo‘g‘inli sifatlar oldiga “more” qo‘yamiz: expensive — more expensive, interesting — more interesting, beautiful — more beautiful, comfortable — more comfortable, modern — more modern. Sifat o‘zgarmaydi, “more” alohida so‘z. O‘zbek tilida “-roq” sifatga yopishadi, ingliz tilida esa uzun sifatlarda alohida so‘z bo‘ladi. “More” ni “-er” bilan birga ishlatmang.
scenes.say_uz: Bu mehmonxona qulayroq. U film qiziqarliroq edi. London Toshkentdan qimmatroq.

scenes.title: Ikki bo‘g‘inli sifatlar
board: more crowded · more boring · more useful · more famous
scenes.say: The metro is more crowded. This lesson is more useful. My new job is busier. The village is quieter.
scenes.say_native: Ikki bo‘g‘inli sifatlarda aniq qoida: “-y” bilan tugasa, “-ier” beramiz: busy — busier, noisy — noisier, heavy — heavier. “-ed”, “-ing”, “-ful”, “-ous” bilan tugasa, “more” ishlatamiz: more crowded, more boring, more useful, more famous. Ba’zilarida ikkala shakl bor, masalan, “quiet” — “quieter”, “simple” — “simpler”. Shubhangiz bo‘lsa, “more” ishlatsangiz ham qo‘pol xato bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Metro gavjumroq. Bu dars foydaliroq. Yangi ishim bandroq. Qishloq tinchroq.

scenes.title: More bigger — qo‘sh qiyos
scenes.say: Bigger, not more bigger. Cheaper, not more cheaper. More expensive, not expensiver.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xil xato bor. Birinchisi: ikkala usulni birga qo‘llash, ya’ni “more bigger”, “more taller”. Qiyosiy daraja faqat bir marta yasaladi: yoki “-er”, yoki “more”. Ikkinchisi teskarisi: uzun sifatga “-er” qo‘shish, masalan, “expensiver” yoki “beautifuler”. Bunday so‘z yo‘q. O‘zbek tilidagi “yana kattaroq” ma’nosini bermoqchi bo‘lsangiz, “even bigger” deng.
scenes.say_uz: Bigger, more bigger emas. Cheaper, more cheaper emas. More expensive, expensiver emas.

scenes.title: Qisqami yoki uzun?
scenes.say: Make the comparative. Cheap. Comfortable. Noisy. Interesting. Hot. Modern.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Oltita sifat uchun qiyosiy darajani ayting. Avval o‘ylang: bu sifat qisqami yoki uzunmi? Cheap, comfortable, noisy, interesting, hot, modern. Ikkinchi va to‘rtinchi uzun sifatlar, “y” bilan tugagan ham bor, ikkilangan undosh ham bor. Ehtiyot bo‘ling.
scenes.say_uz: Qiyosiy darajani yasang. Arzon. Qulay. Shovqinli. Qiziqarli. Issiq. Zamonaviy.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Cheaper. More comfortable. Noisier. More interesting. Hotter. More modern.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: cheaper, more comfortable, noisier, more interesting, hotter, more modern. Ko‘rdingizmi, “noisy” ikki bo‘g‘inli, lekin “y” bilan tugagani uchun “noisier”. “Hot” ning ikkilangan undoshiga e’tibor bering: hotter. “Modern” ikki bo‘g‘inli va “y” bilan tugamaydi, shuning uchun “more modern”. Savol bo‘lsa, ikkinchi va uchinchi sahnalarni eslang.
scenes.say_uz: Arzonroq. Qulayroq. Shovqinliroq. Qiziqarliroq. Issiqroq. Zamonaviyroq.

scenes.title: Istisno shakllar
scenes.say: This phone is better. The weather today is worse than yesterday. The station is further than the market.
scenes.say_native: Uchta istisno sifatni yodlash kerak. “Good” — “better”, “bad” — “worse”, “far” — “further” yoki “farther”. Ular qoidaga bo‘ysunmaydi, shuning uchun ularni xuddi noto‘g‘ri fe’llardek yodlang. “Better” juda ko‘p ishlatiladi: yaxshiroq, sog‘lomroq. “How are you?” — “I’m better, thanks” deganda, “avvalgidan yaxshiman” degan ma’no beradi. “Worse” esa “yomonroq”.
scenes.say_uz: Bu telefon yaxshiroq. Bugun ob-havo kechagidan yomonroq. Bekat bozordan uzoqroq.

scenes.title: Gooder va more better
scenes.say: Better, not gooder. Worse, not badder. Not more better.
scenes.say_native: Mana yana klassik xatolar: “gooder”, “more good”, “more better”, “badder”. Qiyosiy darajaning to‘g‘ri shakli faqat bitta: “better” va “worse”. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “yaxshiroq” so‘zi kabi bitta so‘zda ifodalanadi. Qo‘shimcha “more” kerak emas. “Good” o‘rniga “well” ni ham adashtirmang: “well” ravish, ya’ni “yaxshi”, masalan, “She sings better than me” — u mendan yaxshiroq kuylaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Better, gooder emas. Worse, badder emas. More better emas.

scenes.title: Than — ikkinchi tomon

examples.t: Flying is more expensive than driving.

scenes.say: Tokyo is bigger than Paris. Flying is more expensive than driving. My brother is older than me.
scenes.say_native: Solishtirishda ikkinchi tomon “than” dan keyin keladi. Tuzilma: birinchi narsa, “is”, qiyosiy sifat, “than”, ikkinchi narsa. “Tokyo is bigger than Paris” — Tokio Parijdan kattaroq. O‘zbek tilida bu chiqish kelishigi bilan ifodalanadi: Parij-dan. Ingliz tilida kelishik yo‘q, uning o‘rniga “than” turadi. Savol ham oddiy: “Is Tokyo bigger than Paris?” — Tokio Parijdan kattami?
scenes.say_uz: Tokio Parijdan kattaroq. Uchish mashinada borishdan qimmatroq. Akam mendan kattaroq.

scenes.title: Than dan keyin olmosh
board: taller than me / than him / than her
Your English is better than mine.

examples.t: Your English is better than mine.

scenes.say: She is older than him. My bag is heavier than yours. Your English is better than mine. He is taller than I am.
scenes.say_native: “Than” dan keyin olmosh kelsa, kundalik nutqda “me, him, her, us, them” ishlatiladi: “He is taller than me”. Rasmiyroq va yozma nutqda “than I am” ham deyiladi, ikkalasi to‘g‘ri. Agar “sizniki” deb ega bildirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, “mine, yours, his, hers” ishlating: “My bag is heavier than yours.” Bu yerda “your bag” ni takrorlamaymiz. O‘zbekchada “sizniki” kabi.
scenes.say_uz: U undan kattaroq. Mening sumkam sizniki dan og‘irroq. Sizning inglizchangiz meniki dan yaxshiroq. U mendan balandroq.

scenes.title: Than o‘rniga that, from, of
board: ✓ taller than me / bigger than Paris
scenes.say: Taller than me, not taller that me. Bigger than Paris, not bigger from Paris. Better than him, not better of him.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchi: “than” ni “that” bilan almashtirish, chunki ular talaffuzda o‘xshash. Ikkinchi: “from” ishlatish, chunki o‘zbekcha “-dan” ko‘pincha “from” deb tarjima qilinadi. Uchinchi: “of” qo‘shish. Hammasida bitta to‘g‘ri so‘z: “than”. Talaffuz: “than” gap ichida kuchsiz /ðən/ bo‘ladi, “that” esa /ðæt/. Ular orasidagi farqni quloq bilan ushlab oling.
scenes.say_uz: Taller than me, taller that me emas. Bigger than Paris, from emas. Better than him, of emas.

scenes.title: Than bilan gap tuzing
scenes.say: Make sentences with than. Cars, fast, bikes. Summer, hot, spring. My phone, old, your phone. English, easy, Chinese.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Berilgan so‘zlardan gap tuzing. Birinchi: cars, fast, bikes. Ikkinchi: summer, hot, spring. Uchinchi: my phone, old, your phone. To‘rtinchi: English, easy, Chinese. Sifatni to‘g‘ri qiyosiy darajaga qo‘ying va “than” ni unutmang. Fikringiz haqiqatga mos kelmasa ham, shaklga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say_uz: “Than” bilan gap tuzing. Mashinalar, tez, velosipedlar. Yoz, issiq, bahor. Mening telefonim, eski, sizning telefoningiz. Ingliz tili, oson, xitoy tili.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: My phone is older than yours.
scenes.say: Cars are faster than bikes. Summer is hotter than spring. My phone is older than yours. English is easier than Chinese.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “Cars are faster than bikes”. Bu yerda “cars” ko‘plik, shuning uchun “are”. “Summer is hotter than spring”. “My phone is older than yours”. “English is easier than Chinese”: “easy” — “easier”, “y” ni “i” ga almashtirdik. Agar “is” va “are” ni adashtirgan bo‘lsangiz, ega bir yoki ko‘pligini tekshiring. Qolgani to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, ajoyib!
scenes.say_uz: Mashinalar velosipedlardan tezroq. Yoz bahordan issiqroq. Mening telefonim siznikidan eskiroq. Ingliz tili xitoy tilidan osonroq.

scenes.title: as … as — teng daraja
board: I am as tall as my brother.

examples.t: This bus is as fast as the train.

scenes.say: I am as tall as my brother. This bus is as fast as the train. She is as busy as I am.
scenes.say_native: Agar ikki narsa teng bo‘lsa, “as… as” tuzilmasini ishlatamiz. Ikkita “as” orasiga sifatning oddiy, asl shaklini qo‘yamiz: “as tall as”, “as fast as”. Ya’ni “-er” yoki “more” kerak emas. O‘zbek tilida bu “-dek”, “kabi”, “…chalik” ma’nolariga yaqin: “akamdek baland”. Yana bir ibora: “the same as” — xuddi shunday. “My phone is the same as yours.”
scenes.say_uz: Men akamdek balandman. Bu avtobus poyezddek tez. U men kabi band.

scenes.title: not as … as — kamroq
board: Bukhara isn't as big as Tashkent.

examples.t: Bukhara isn't as big as Tashkent.
The bus isn't as fast as the train.

scenes.say: Bukhara isn't as big as Tashkent. The bus isn't as fast as the train. Tea is not as strong as coffee.
scenes.say_native: “Not as… as” bir narsa ikkinchisidan kam ekanini bildiradi: “Bukhara isn’t as big as Tashkent” — Buxoro Toshkentchalik katta emas. Bu ma’no jihatidan “Tashkent is bigger than Bukhara” ga teng. Ikki yo‘l ham to‘g‘ri, lekin “not as… as” yumshoqroq eshitiladi, chunki biz kimdir yomon deb aytmaymiz, faqat farqni ko‘rsatamiz. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “…chalik emas” ga mos keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Buxoro Toshkentchalik katta emas. Avtobus poyezdchalik tez emas. Choy kofechalik kuchli emas.

scenes.title: as … than va as taller as
scenes.say: As tall as, not as tall than. As tall as, not as taller as. Taller than.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita tuzilmani aralashtirmang. “As… as” da ikkinchi so‘z “as”, “than” emas, sifat esa asl shaklida: “as tall as”. “Taller than” da esa “-er” va “than” turadi. Xato variantlar: “as tall than”, “as taller as”. Eslab qolish usuli: “as” bilan “as” juft, “-er” bilan “than” juft. Ikki juftni aralashtirmang. Va yana: “the same as”, “the same than” emas.
scenes.say_uz: As tall as, as tall than emas. As tall as, as taller as emas. Taller than.

scenes.title: Ma’nosi bir xil gap
board: 1) Tea is cheaper than coffee. → Coffee isn't ___ ___ tea.
2) I am 20. She is 20. → I'm ___ old ___ she is.
scenes.say: Rewrite with the same meaning. Tea is cheaper than coffee, so coffee is not as ... as tea. I am twenty and she is twenty, so I am as ... as she is.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ma’nosi bir xil gap tuzing. Birinchi: choy kofedan arzon. Kofe choychalik … emas. Bo‘sh joylarga to‘g‘ri so‘zlarni qo‘ying: sifat va ikkinchi “as”. Ikkinchi: men yigirma yoshdaman, u ham yigirma yoshda. Men u … yoshdaman. Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Gapni qayta yozing. Choy kofedan arzon. Kofe choychalik … emas. Men yigirma yoshdaman, u ham. Men u kabi … yoshdaman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Coffee isn't as cheap as tea.
2) I'm as old as she is.
scenes.say: Coffee isn't as cheap as tea. I'm as old as she is.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “Coffee isn’t as cheap as tea”. Bu yerda “cheap” asl shaklida, “cheaper” emas, chunki “as… as” orasida sifat o‘zgarmaydi. Ikkinchi: “I’m as old as she is” yoki “as old as her”. Aytgancha, yoshni so‘rash uchun “How old are you?” ishlatamiz: bu yerda ham “old” asl shaklida turibdi. Bu “as… as” qoidasiga mos keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Kofe choychalik arzon emas. Men u kabi yoshdaman.

scenes.title: Much va a lot: katta farq

examples.t: A flat in London is much more expensive.
This laptop is a lot faster.

scenes.say: A flat in London is much more expensive. This laptop is a lot faster. Her English is far better than mine.
scenes.say_native: Farq katta bo‘lsa, qiyosiy darajadan oldin “much”, “a lot” yoki “far” qo‘yamiz: “much bigger”, “a lot more expensive”, “far better”. O‘zbek tilida bu “ancha, ancha kattaroq, ancha yaxshiroq” ga mos keladi. Eslab qoling: bu so‘zlar qiyosiy shakldan oldin turadi, “very” esa qiyosiy daraja bilan ishlatilmaydi. “Much bigger” deymiz, “very bigger” demaymiz. Bu yerda “far” ham ravish vazifasida, masofa emas.
scenes.say_uz: Londonda kvartira ancha qimmatroq. Bu noutbuk ancha tezroq. Uning ingliz tili meniknidan ancha yaxshiroq.

scenes.title: A bit, a little: kichik farq
board: a bit / a little / slightly + qiyosiy

examples.t: This shop is a bit cheaper.

scenes.say: This shop is a bit cheaper. My brother is a little older. It is slightly warmer today.
scenes.say_native: Farq kichik bo‘lsa, “a bit”, “a little” yoki “slightly” ishlatamiz: “a bit cheaper” — sal arzonroq, “a little older” — biroz kattaroq, “slightly warmer” — biroz iliqroq. “A bit” kundalik nutqda juda ko‘p uchraydi, “slightly” esa rasmiyroq. O‘zbek tilida bu “sal, biroz” so‘zlariga mos keladi. Taqqoslang: “much cheaper” — ancha arzonroq, “a bit cheaper” — sal arzonroq. Bir so‘z bilan siz farq miqdorini aytasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bu do‘kon sal arzonroq. Akam biroz kattaroq. Bugun biroz iliqroq.

scenes.title: Very taller — xato
board: ✓ much taller / a lot more expensive
scenes.say: Much taller, not very taller. A lot more expensive, not very more expensive. Much bigger, not more much bigger.
scenes.say_native: Muhim xato: qiyosiy daraja bilan “very” ishlatish. “Very tall” to‘g‘ri, chunki sifat oddiy shaklda. Lekin “very taller” noto‘g‘ri. Qiyosiy darajaga “much”, “a lot”, “far” yoki “a bit”, “slightly” mos keladi. Ikkinchi xato: tartibni buzish, “more much bigger”. Tartib: avval farq so‘zi, keyin qiyosiy daraja: “much bigger”. Uchinchi eslatma: “very much better” deyish mumkin, bu yerda “very” “much” ni kuchaytiryapti.
scenes.say_uz: Much taller, very taller emas. A lot more expensive, very more expensive emas. Much bigger, more much bigger emas.

scenes.title: Much yoki a bit?
board: 1) Tashkent ≈ 2.5 million · Bukhara ≈ 280,000. Tashkent is ___ bigger.
2) Tea 2 dollars, coffee 2.20 dollars. Tea is ___ cheaper.
scenes.say: Much or a bit? Tashkent is bigger than Bukhara. Tea is cheaper than coffee. Today is hotter. I am heavier.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Raqamlarga qarab “much” yoki “a bit” tanlang. Birinchi: Toshkentda taxminan ikki yarim million, Buxoroda taxminan ikki yuz sakson ming aholi. Ikkinchi: choy ikki dollar, kofe ikki dollar yigirma sent. Uchinchi: qirq daraja va o‘ttiz daraja. To‘rtinchi: ellik bir kilo va ellik kilo. Farq katta bo‘lsa “much”, kichik bo‘lsa “a bit”.
scenes.say_uz: Much yoki a bit? Toshkent Buxorodan kattaroq. Choy kofedan arzonroq. Bugun issiqroq. Men og‘irroqman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Tashkent is much bigger. Tea is a bit cheaper. Today is much hotter. I am a bit heavier.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “much bigger”, farq juda katta. Ikkinchi, “a bit cheaper”, farq faqat yigirma sent. Uchinchi, “much hotter”, o‘n daraja ancha. To‘rtinchi, “a bit heavier”, bir kilo, juda kam. Ko‘rdingizmi, siz raqamlarga qarab farq miqdorini tanlayapsiz. Real hayotda ham shunday qilasiz: “a bit” va “much” mazmunni aniqroq qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Toshkent ancha kattaroq. Choy sal arzonroq. Bugun ancha issiqroq. Men sal og‘irroqman.

scenes.title: Taqqoslash uchun so‘zlar
board: Shahar: crowded · quiet · safe · clean · expensive
Odam: tall · young · friendly · busy · funny
Mahsulot: cheap · fast · light · reliable · modern

examples.t: Life in a village is quieter.

scenes.say: Cities can be crowded, quiet, safe or clean. People can be friendly, funny or busy. Products can be cheap, light, fast or reliable.
scenes.say_native: Solishtirish uchun kerakli sifatlar. Shahar uchun: crowded — gavjum, quiet — tinch, safe — xavfsiz, clean — toza, expensive — qimmat. Odam uchun: tall — baland, young — yosh, friendly — samimiy, funny — kulgili. Mahsulot uchun: cheap — arzon, light — yengil, fast — tez, reliable — ishonchli. Shu so‘zlarni qiyosiy darajaga qo‘yib, mashq qiling: safer, lighter, friendlier, more reliable.
scenes.say_uz: Shaharlar gavjum, tinch, xavfsiz yoki toza bo‘lishi mumkin. Odamlar samimiy, kulgili yoki band bo‘lishi mumkin. Mahsulotlar arzon, yengil, tez yoki ishonchli bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: Telefon tanlash
board: B: This one is faster, but it's much more expensive.
A: The other one is cheaper and a bit lighter.
scenes.say: Which phone is better? This one is faster, and the camera is better. But it is much more expensive. The other one is cheaper and a bit lighter, but it is not as fast as this one. I think I'll take the cheaper one. Good idea. It is not as good, but it is good enough.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Xaridor ikki telefonni solishtiryapti. Savol: qaysi telefon yaxshiroq? Tinglang va sezing: ikkita telefon, bir nechta qiyosiy sifat va “much”, “a bit”, “not as… as” ham bor. Siz uchun vazifa: birinchi telefonning ustunliklarini, ikkinchisining ustunliklarini va oxirgi qarorni aniqlash.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi telefon yaxshiroq? Bu tezroq va kamerasi yaxshiroq. Lekin ancha qimmat. Ikkinchisi arzonroq va sal yengilroq, lekin bunchalik tez emas. Menimcha, arzonini olaman. Yaxshi fikr. U unchalik yaxshi emas, lekin yetarlicha yaxshi.

scenes.title: Dialog 1 haqida savollar
scenes.say: Which phone is faster? Which phone is cheaper? What does the customer buy?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: qaysi telefon tezroq? Ikkinchi: qaysi telefon arzonroq? Uchinchi: xaridor nimani sotib oladi? Javobni qiyosiy daraja bilan bering: “The first phone is faster”. Birinchi va ikkinchi telefonlarni nomlang.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi telefon tezroq? Qaysi telefon arzonroq? Xaridor nimani sotib oladi?

scenes.title: Dialog 1: javoblar
board: 3) He / she buys the cheaper one.
scenes.say: The first phone is faster. The second phone is cheaper. The customer buys the cheaper one.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi telefon tezroq va kamerasi yaxshiroq, lekin ancha qimmat. Ikkinchisi arzonroq va sal yengilroq. Xaridor arzonini oladi. E’tibor bering: “the cheaper one” — arzonroq bittasi. “One” ismning o‘rnini bosdi, shuning uchun “phone” ni takrorlamadik. Bu ham tabiiy nutqning belgisi.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi telefon tezroq. Ikkinchisi arzonroq. Xaridor arzonroq bittasini oladi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: Ikki shahar
board: A: Is London bigger than Manchester?
B: Yes, much bigger, and more expensive.
A: Is Manchester as busy as London?
B: No, it's quieter, but it's friendlier.
scenes.say: Is London bigger than Manchester? Yes, much bigger and a lot more expensive. Is Manchester as busy as London? No, it is quieter, but the people are friendlier. And the weather? The weather is a bit rainier in Manchester. So which one is better for a student? For a student, Manchester is cheaper, so it is better.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Do‘stlar ikki shaharni solishtiryapti, London va Manchester. Bu yerda savol qiyosiy darajada beriladi: “Is London bigger than Manchester?” Javobda “much bigger”, “quieter”, “friendlier”, “a bit rainier”. Oxirida xulosa bor. Tinglang va qaysi shahar talaba uchun yaxshi ekanini va nima uchun ekanini aniqlang.
scenes.say_uz: London Manchesterdan kattami? Ha, ancha katta va ancha qimmat. Manchester London kabi bandmi? Yo‘q, tinchroq, lekin odamlari samimiyroq. Ob-havo-chi? Manchesterda sal yomg‘irliroq. Talaba uchun qaysi biri yaxshi? Talaba uchun Manchester arzonroq, shuning uchun yaxshiroq.

scenes.title: Dialog 2 haqida savollar
board: 3) Which one is better for a student, and why?
scenes.say: Which city is bigger? Which city is friendlier? Which one is better for a student, and why?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: qaysi shahar kattaroq? Ikkinchi: qaysi shahar samimiyroq? Uchinchi: talaba uchun qaysi biri yaxshi va nima uchun? Uchinchisiga “because” bilan javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi shahar kattaroq? Qaysi shahar samimiyroq? Talaba uchun qaysi biri yaxshi va nega?

scenes.title: Dialog 2: javoblar
scenes.say: London is bigger. Manchester is friendlier. Manchester is better for a student because it is cheaper.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: London kattaroq, Manchesterning odamlari samimiyroq, talaba uchun Manchester yaxshiroq, chunki arzonroq. Dialogda uchta usul ishlatildi: “than” bilan taqqoslash, “as… as” savolda va “much”, “a bit” bilan farq miqdori. Ayni shu uchtasini birlashtirsangiz, har qanday ikki shaharni solishtira olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: London kattaroq. Manchester samimiyroq. Talaba uchun Manchester yaxshiroq, chunki arzonroq.

scenes.title: Talaffuz va urg‘u

examples.t: My flat is BIGger than yours.

scenes.say: My flat is BIGger than yours. This is as GOOD as that. It is much MORE expensive.
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz. Gapda urg‘u sifatga tushadi, “than” va “as” esa kuchsiz, tez aytiladi: “than” /ðən/, “as” /əz/. “Bigger than yours” deganda, “BIG-ger” aniq, “than” deyarli eshitilmaydi. Qiyosiy “-er” qo‘shimchasi Britaniya talaffuzida kuchsiz “a” kabi: tall-er, “TAW-la”. “More” esa uzun, “mor” kabi. Bu qoidalarga amal qilsangiz, ingliz tilida gapirganingiz tabiiyroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Mening kvartiram sizinikidan KATTAroq. Bu u kabi YAXshi. U ancha QIMMATroq.

scenes.title: Xatolarni toping
board: 1) This flat is more big than that one.
4) He is gooder than me at English.
scenes.say: Find and fix the mistakes. This flat is more big than that one. She is taller that me. My phone is very cheaper. He is gooder than me at English.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir gapda xato bor. Birinchi: bu kvartira ikkinchisidan katta, lekin “more big” deyilgan. Ikkinchi: “that me”. Uchinchi: “very cheaper”. To‘rtinchi: “gooder”. To‘g‘rilab, to‘liq gapni ayting. Oldingi darslarimizdagi xatolar ro‘yxatini eslang.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolarni tuzating. Bu kvartira katta. U mendan baland. Telefonim juda arzonroq. U mendan yaxshiroq.

scenes.title: Xatolar tuzatilishi
scenes.say: This flat is bigger than that one. She is taller than me. My phone is much cheaper. He is better than me at English.
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri variantlar: “This flat is bigger than that one”. “She is taller than me”. “My phone is much cheaper”, yoki “a lot cheaper”. “He is better than me at English”. Ko‘rdingizmi, to‘rttasi ham biz bugun ko‘rgan xatolar edi: qo‘sh qiyos, “that”, “very” va “gooder”. Endi bu xatolarni o‘zingiz yozgan matnda ham topa olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kvartira u kvartiradan kattaroq. U mendan balandroq. Telefonim ancha arzonroq. U ingliz tilida mendan yaxshiroq.

scenes.title: Ikki shahar: o‘z gaplaringiz
board: 8 sentences: bigger · cheaper · quieter · as … as · much / a bit
scenes.say: Now compare two cities. Make eight sentences. Use than, as as, much and a bit. Start with: Tashkent is bigger than...
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz ikki shaharni tanlab, ularni solishtiring. Kamida sakkizta gap aytishingiz kerak. Ulardan birida “as… as” yoki “not as… as”, kamida ikkitasida “much” yoki “a bit” bo‘lsin. Sifatlarni oldingi sahnadagi ro‘yxatdan oling: crowded, quiet, safe, clean, expensive. Birinchi gap: “Tashkent is bigger than…”. Gapiring.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki shaharni solishtiring. Sakkizta gap tuzing. Than, as as, much va a bit ishlating. Boshlang: Tashkent is bigger than...

scenes.title: Namuna: ikki shahar
board: Samarkand isn't as crowded as Tashkent.
The metro in Tashkent is much faster than the bus.
scenes.say: Tashkent is much bigger than Samarkand. It is also busier and noisier. Samarkand is quieter and a bit cheaper. Samarkand isn't as crowded as Tashkent. Life in Tashkent is faster, but it is more modern. Samarkand is as beautiful as Tashkent. For a holiday, Samarkand is better. For work, Tashkent is better.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: Toshkent Samarqanddan ancha kattaroq. U yana bandroq va shovqinliroq. Samarqand tinchroq va sal arzonroq. Samarqand Toshkentchalik gavjum emas. Toshkentda hayot tezroq, lekin zamonaviyroq. Samarqand Toshkentdek go‘zal. Dam olish uchun Samarqand yaxshiroq, ish uchun esa Toshkent. Sizning sakkizta gapingiz ham shu tartibda bo‘lishi kerak: farq, sabab, xulosa.
scenes.say_uz: Toshkent Samarqanddan ancha kattaroq. U yana bandroq va shovqinliroq. Samarqand tinchroq va sal arzonroq. U Toshkentchalik gavjum emas. Toshkentda hayot tezroq, lekin zamonaviyroq. Samarqand Toshkentdek go‘zal. Dam olish uchun Samarqand yaxshiroq, ish uchun Toshkent.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: than  ·  as … as  ·  not as … as
much / a lot / a bit + comparative
scenes.say: Great job! You can now compare cities, people and products with comparatives.
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Qisqa sifat — “-er”, uzun sifat — “more”, “y” bilan tugagan ikki bo‘g‘inli — “-ier”. Istisnolar: better, worse, further. Ikkinchi tomon “than” dan keyin. Tenglik uchun “as… as”, kamlik uchun “not as… as”. Farq katta bo‘lsa — “much, a lot, far”, kichik bo‘lsa — “a bit, a little, slightly”. Eng ko‘p xatolar: “more bigger”, “that”, “very taller”, “gooder”. Endi siz ularni bilasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Barakalla! Endi qiyosiy daraja yordamida shaharlarni, odamlarni va mahsulotlarni solishtira olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: than · as … as · much / a bit
scenes.say: Your homework is to compare two cities in eight sentences. See you next time!
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: ikki shaharni sakkizta gapda solishtiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida beshta gapda “than”, bir gapda “as… as” yoki “not as… as”, ikkita gapda “much” yoki “a bit”, hamda kamida bitta “better” yoki “worse” bo‘lsin. Gaplarni yozib, keyin ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Keyingi darsda orttirma darajani o‘rganamiz: eng yaxshi, eng katta.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: ikki shaharni sakkizta gapda solishtiring. Ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Ikki shaharni sakkizta gapda solishtiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida beshta gapda than, bitta gapda as … as yoki not as … as, ikkita gapda much yoki a bit, hamda better yoki worse ishlatilsin.
